sentiment.title: Sentiment Trend
sentiment.description: Shows the overall sentiment breakdown (positive/neutral/negative) for the selected period and highlights the dominant sentiment. Helpful to track shifts in how people feel about the topic.
sentiment.interpretation_1: Sentiment distribution shows {sentiment} as the largest share ({pct}%).
sentiment.interpretation_3: Monitor changes to sentiment mix over time — a shift of more than 5% may indicate a meaningful trend.

keywords_by_sentiment.title: Top Keywords by Sentiment
keywords_by_sentiment.description: Top keywords grouped by sentiment. Helps identify which terms are driving positive, neutral or negative conversations.

countries_by_sentiment.title: Top Countries by Sentiment
countries_by_sentiment.description: Shows which countries contribute the most to each sentiment bucket. Useful to locate regional differences in sentiment.

top_mentions.heading: Total Mentions
top_mentions.title: Total mentions summary
top_mentions.description: A compact summary card showing the total number of mentions in the sample and a short AI-generated insight pointing to the top sources.
top_mentions.interpretation_action: Consider reviewing content from {label} to understand drivers of reach.

total_reach.heading: Total Reach
total_reach.title: Total reach
total_reach.description: Displays total reach across the selected sample (sum of estimated audience reach). Useful to understand overall visibility and compare periods.

source_distribution.title: Mentions Distribution by source
source_distribution.description: Breakdown of mentions across different sources (e.g., Facebook, X, Instagram) over time. Use this to see which channels drive the most conversation.
source_distribution.interpretation_top: Across {periods} periods, {top} contributed the largest share ({pct}%).

share_of_voice.title: Share of voice
share_of_voice.description: Displays how conversation is shared between categories (or competitors). It highlights the largest contributor to the overall share and helps assess relative visibility.
share_of_voice.interpretation_top: Top category is {top} with {pct}% of the share of voice.

share_of_voice_by_source.title: Share of Voice by Source Type
share_of_voice_by_source.description: Distribution of topics across source types.
share_of_voice_by_source.insight: Certain topics dominate specific source types; for example, Pinterest shows strong interest in charging and range.

share_of_voice_donut.title: Share of Voice by Mentions
share_of_voice_donut.insight: Autonomous driving and charging speed are the dominant topics in mentions.

mentions_trend.title: Mentions Trend by Source Type
mentions_trend.description: Trend of mentions over time by source type.
mentions_trend.insight: Mentions trended highest on News and WeChat over the period.

top_keywords.title: Top keywords
top_keywords.description: A visual layout of the top keywords; size indicates prominence. Useful to quickly scan common themes and surface the most-mentioned terms.

total_mentions.title: Total Mentions
total_mentions.description: Shows the total number of mentions over the selected period and quick growth metrics. Use this to monitor volume changes and spot spikes or drops in attention.

audience.audience_data_based: The audience data is based on {source}

credibility.tooltip_followers: To determine the followers credibility score for historical accounts, we evaluate several factors, including the presence of a profile picture and bio, the number of posts, and the ratio between followers and following. Brands with an authentic audience typically achieve scores of 80 or higher.
credibility.tooltip_likers: To determine the credibility score of historical likers, we evaluate several factors such as the account’s profile picture and bio, number of followers and posts, and the follower-to-following ratio. Brands with a genuinely engaged audience typically achieve scores of 80 or higher.

interpretation.action: Focus on increasing the proportion of 'Real' followers for better credibility.

interest_affinity.title: Audience interest affinity
interest_affinity.tooltip: What the audience is interested in, based on analyzing posts for caption texts, @mentions, #hashtags and location tags.

interpretation.tailor: Consider tailoring content to match this interest for higher engagement.
interpretation.diversify: Diversifying content may help reach other segments as well.

reachability.title: Audience Reach Distribution
reachability.tooltip: Shows the percentage of followers segmented by the number of accounts they follow, over 1,500, between 1,000-1,500, 500-1,000, and under 500. Followers who follow more than 1,500 accounts are less likely to see sponsored content.

interpretation.top: Most followers ({value}%) are in {label}, representing {pct}% of the audience.
interpretation.visibility: Followers with fewer connections are more likely to see your content.
interpretation.action: Consider targeting this segment for higher reach and engagement.

interpretation.tailor: Content tailored to this country may increase engagement.
interpretation.action: Consider strategies to engage audiences in other countries for broader reach.

gender_distribution.title: Gender Distribution
gender_distribution.tooltip: The audience’s gender distribution is determined by analyzing indicators such as the profile picture, name, bio text, and selfies from recent posts.

interpretation.tailor: Tailoring content to this group may increase engagement.
interpretation.action: Consider strategies to engage other gender segments for broader reach.

a11y.price_slider: Slide horizontally to switch between monthly and yearly prices
